scope: External QEMU observation only. Reset capability, fresh C0 and complete C0/C1/C2 capture are distinct outcomes. This contract supplies no actual capability evidence. Independent RSP1/CAP1 interface review and coordinator author assignments are accepted; gate-first controls and exact prelaunch review remain required. C0 implementation remains held.

precedence.rule: This is a narrower executable preparation interface. It does not change the parent's three-checkpoint completion condition, guest authority, global bounds or seven false claims. Root owns schema registration and any change to those contracts. The companion plan explains unresolved execution prerequisites.

slice_ownership.behavior: Bounded ACK-mode RSP transport, fixed reset operations, source-bound target XML and reset-register decoder. No launcher or guest-memory API.
One owned reset-paused VM capability observation using RSP1 and existing checked inputs/ESP/argv/cleanup. No resume, breakpoint or memory read.
Later pure strict C0 artifact, ordinary-RAM layout, paging and public EFI decoder. Implementation remains held for source-bitmask/schema review and actual CAP1 result.

One C0-only multiplexed wire with a shared ledger and fixed paused QMP prelaunch handshake on borrowed unbuffered endpoints. Retains actual partial writes and frame receipt clocks. Socket fixtures exercise the boundary. The future collector owns launch, endpoint closure and final drain.
Later owned fresh-C0 collector. Root must separately freeze its typed transport additions, source audit, assertions and exact launch plan.

inherited_helpers.restriction: Do not call run_probe: it resumes the guest. Existing QMP allowlist is not broadened. CAP1 owns a separate exact dispatcher and one multiplexed stream owner; no competing socket readers. Existing helper changes require a new reviewed proposal.

status_semantics.PASS: Only the named subset's actual completed assertions; never full Oracle acceptance.
status_semantics.INCOMPLETE: Absent input/evidence, unsupported actual capability or CPU/layout mode, deadline/storage/event exhaustion, uncertain response/cleanup, missing stop, differing repeated observations, or incomplete EOF. Preserve actual observations and uncertainty; stop before another observation dispatch.
status_semantics.DENY: Present malformed artifact, pin mismatch, invalid grammar/type/length, contradictory identity, forbidden operation, unsafe address span or arithmetic overflow. A local pre-dispatch forbidden request does not poison an otherwise unambiguous transport; test the next allowed operation. A malformed/ambiguous remote reply terminalizes that session.
status_semantics.no_fallback: No automatic retry, reconnect, alternate address/profile, scan, parser repair, packet padding, virtual-read fallback, injected call or invented response. Coordinator may authorize a separately reviewed fresh run.

prelaunch.profile: Reuse the reviewed q35-8.2-tcg-qemu64-virtio-ro-esp-debugcon-v0 input profile and fixed argv builder. Bind new observer and source dossier separately; do not mutate retained prior inputs/profile. Bind exact source, EFI/PDB GUID+age, init, tool/package, DEBUG CODE, initial VARS, read-only independently checked ESP, argv and actual observer bytes.
prelaunch.source_correspondence: Before execution require coordinator-reviewed official Ubuntu 1:8.2.2+ds-0ubuntu1.18 source/package dossier, signed publisher metadata, installed executable byte identity and relevant downstream source differences. Upstream tag alone is insufficient. Include gdbstub/system.c, gdbstub/gdbstub.c, target/i386/gdbstub.c, target/i386/cpu.c, target/i386/cpu-dump.c, system/memory.c, system/physmem.c, monitor/hmp-cmds-target.c, hw/intc/apic.c, hw/intc/apic_common.c, gdb-xml/i386-64bit.xml and scripts/feature_to_c.py.
prelaunch.paths: Fresh private run directory mode0700; evidence/clone mode0600; executable input modes preserved. Reject symlink, hardlink, directory/FIFO/device inputs and path traversal. Fresh private AF_UNIX sockets only, no public listener. Original inputs are bounded and pinned before launch and checked again afterward; no post-return immutability claim.
prelaunch.authority: One actual Popen child in its own process group, private initial-VARS clone, read-only CODE and ESP, no network/passthrough/hardware, fixed -S and one vCPU. No attach to pre-existing VM. Root serializes launch against other timed jobs and authorizes an exact fresh invocation.
prelaunch.teardown: The original absolute deadline includes connect, responses, drain and cleanup. Reserve5s. QMP quit has no trailing whitespace; only an actual matching quit acknowledgement enables <=0.5s graceful wait clipped to the same deadline. Then existing owned TERM/KILL fallback and actual wait/reap. Never numeric-PID fallback. Retain actions, grace outcome, return code and per-stream actual EOF/errors separately. Drain unaffected streams under original bounds after a stream error; error is not EOF. Missing EOF/reap or report-finalization failure cannot PASS.

budgets.full_oracle_unchanged: C0/C1/C2: <=60s each required stop, <=180s VM, <=5s response, <=1024 paired operations, <=256 distinct (checkpoint,physical frame) snapshots, <=64KiB other RAM, <=64KiB map and <=32MiB retained evidence. A stricter C0 subset bound does not increase any parent bound. Rechecks consume request/event/read/storage budgets and later stops consume fresh snapshots.
budgets.charging: Check every cap before dispatch/allocation/retention. One monotonic absolute deadline, clipped per-operation deadlines; chunks, transient EAGAIN/EINTR and teardown cannot reset it. ACKs/raw bytes/XML count cumulatively. QMP async objects count too. Reserve a bounded INCOMPLETE terminal report even if detailed report exceeds its cap.

rsp1_api.wire: RSPWire.read_chunk(deadline:float,max_bytes:int)->bytes; RSPWire.write_all(data:bytes,deadline:float)->None. CAP1 owns its fresh socket and multiplexed drain. Wire supplies bytes only; RSPClient is the sole packet/operation authority. Raw incoming/outgoing bytes are retained before interpretation, with direction and monotonic boundaries. Tests use real sockets and transport spies.
codec: Frame is exactly ACK, NACK or PACKET(payload:bytes,raw:bytes); codec carries incomplete fragments across calls under cumulative limits

types.RegisterSnapshot: Immutable {raw_payload:bytes,raw_bytes:bytes,values:tuple[int,...]}; exactly66 values in XML order. Observations only, not guest authority.
types.RSPOperation: Immutable {name:str,request_packet:bytes,response_packet:bytes|null,response_payload:bytes|null,started_ns:int,finished_ns:int|null,result:ok|error|timeout|pending}. client.operations returns tuple snapshots in dispatch order, one row per packet including each XML chunk. Install pending before write. Closed names: supported,thread_first,thread_next,thread_current,thread_general,thread_continue,feature_target,feature_core,reset_registers,qemu_supported,physical_mode_query,physical_mode_enable. No row for local pre-dispatch denial. ACKs remain raw-wire evidence. Semantic failure marks the actual reply row error; partial write/response ambiguity remains pending or error/timeout as actually known, never successful.
types.errors: Typed reason with DENY or INCOMPLETE and terminal flag. No arbitrary public request(payload) or remote-monitor command API. Shared existing Budget counts QMP objects and RSP packets; separate RSP wire/ACK/XML limits are stricter local caps, not additional lifetime allowances.

rsp_wire.mode: ACK mode only; no QStartNoAckMode. One pending request. Check checksum of exact encoded payload before unescape; bounded fragments/coalesced frames accepted. Emit '+' only for valid response packet. Preserve request ACK separately from command result. Unexpected NACK, corrupt checksum, unsolicited packet, empty required capability, missing ACK/response, EOF or unsupported RLE terminalizes with retained raw evidence; no retransmission.
rsp_wire.encoding: ASCII fixed commands; hexadecimal numeric fields lowercase on transmit. Packet '$' payload '#' two hexadecimal checksum digits. Handle standard '}' XOR0x20 escape with decoded bound4096. Unescaped '*' RLE is unsupported and terminal; the pinned QEMU writer does not need it. Escaped literal '*' is data. No console 'O' or notification '%' normalization; unexpected payload types are unsupported and terminal. An ACK alone never means operation success.

m/l chunks, contiguous progress from0; final l; bounded target grammar below

Only while verified reset-paused with no resume ever; exactly1216 hex characters decoding608 bytes

rsp_wire.xml: target.xml must equal the source-generated single-core target shape: XML1.0 declaration, inert DOCTYPE target SYSTEM gdb-target.dtd, target, architecture i386:x86-64, exactly xi:include href=i386-64bit.xml, close target. The generated xi prefix is unbound; use this exact byte grammar rather than repairing arbitrary XML namespaces. Core annex must byte-match the independently pinned downstream gdb-xml/i386-64bit.xml (upstreamSHA1b3acc75743d5cea86aadda52e75a9ecdcbaefa89050d1aae8c4d8f3dd880953 if correspondence confirms). Feature-to-C preserves source bytes. Accept only that known inert DOCTYPE; never fetch DTD, resolve entities, internal subsets, network/file includes or extra annexes. Record actual raw chunks and assembled bytes.

register_layout.rule: Sequential little-endian register values, no unavailable x bytes/padding/truncation/guessed offsets. TARGET_X86_64 GDB_FORCE_64 applies even at reset; the source's mode-dependent write helper is not used. This is an emulator register observation, not executed CPUID.

cap1_qmp.qom_get: Only properties realized and phys-bits on the sole query-cpus-fast CPU0 qom-path; retain that reply. Path must be exact returned bounded ASCII path<=256 with no caller substitution. realized must be JSON true; phys-bits must be exact integer32..52, never bool/0/model-expansion default. Each getter's installed source and no-write behavior must be in the dossier.
cap1_qmp.rules: Strict bounded newline JSON, duplicate keys/nonfinite numbers rejected, exact response ID and one pending request. HMP strings are constants, no arguments or caller-supplied text. query-status must remain running=false and status=prelaunch at initial/final reset brackets; unexpected RESUME/RESET/STOP or changed status terminalizes. query-cpus-fast must show exactly CPU0 on expected x86_64 target. Host thread-id is not RSPthread01. QMP events retained separately. HMP dump must identify CPU0/SMM=0 and agree with overlapping g values; parse CPL/CS64/GDTR/IDTR without guest-memory reads. HMP dump source uses CPU_DUMP_FPU, not CPU_DUMP_CODE.
cap1_qmp.physical_mode_scope: Set/readback proves protocol state only. No m or guest resume; no RAM-access or breakpoint-hit claim. Reset APIC source initializes vapic_paddr=0, making the CR8 path in reset g narrowly defensible. Any guest execution before g invalidates this premise.

memory_view.source_rule: QEMU physical RSP mode calls cpu_physical_memory_read on global address_space_memory and returns success even for MMIO/transaction errors. Transport OK is no RAM proof. Never use CPU virtual-debug translation or monitor mapping walkers as the check.
memory_view.admission: Parse complete bounded info mtree -f output. Select exactly one FlatView containing AS memory with root system; require AS cpu-memory-0/root system belongs to the same FlatView, actual SMM=0 and sole CPU0. Reject missing/ambiguous/unknown row grammar, wrapped endpoints, overlap, duplicate AS ownership or inconsistent flatview identity. Do not select cpu-smm-0 or I/O AS.
memory_view.ram: Only ordinary ram rows named pc.ram, with complete checked physical interval and source-derived backing offset. Require identity mapping: physical start equals backing offset; implicit missing offset is0 only. Reject ramd, nv-ram, rom, romd, I/O, holes, overlays, nonidentity aliases and overlapping backing ranges. Check entire requested span fits admitted ordinary-RAM interval(s) without gaps BEFORE dispatch; split only into independently checked spans. All table and object reads obey this rule.
memory_view.freshness: CAP1 layout is capability evidence only. Recapture at actual C0 and each later stop; no earlier layout authorizes reads. The QMP stopped witness is not device/DMA quiescence. Register/layout brackets plus repeated table/object reads may establish observed equality only, never an atomic all-RAM snapshot or future continuity.

c0_candidate_and_stop.candidate: Use only prior actual unique full-stream diagnostic admitted by boot_profile_inputs and bound by explicit field mapping to this exact source/tool/firmware/EFI/symbol/init/ESP/initial-VARS profile. The prior admission-profile digest and probe-profile digest differ by schema and are not interchangeable. Never copy an address from this contract as authority. No hint =>INCOMPLETE; malformed/mismatched hint=>DENY.
c0_candidate_and_stop.later_transport: C0C adds reviewed typed Z1,<candidate>,1 / z1,<same>,1 (OK required), c with no address/signal, whitelisted p reads and checked physical m. Exactly one active hardware execution breakpoint. No software breakpoints, ?, bulk g after resume, single stepping, register/memory writes or injected calls. This extension is not authorized in RSP1/CAP1.
c0_candidate_and_stop.actual_stop: Bind the actual asynchronous T05thread:01; stop to the one original c, the sole successful Z1 and actual RSP p10 RIP==candidate. Require fresh QMP running=false/status=debug and HMP CPU0/SMM=0. QEMU lacks a hwbreak reason in this reply: T05 alone proves no breakpoint cause. '?' fabricates T05 and removes breakpoints, so it is forbidden. After acknowledged c, send no RSP bytes until the genuine asynchronous stop packet arrives: even an ordinary byte/duplicate ACK can pause this server. No keepalive/poll/interrupt byte. Unexpected stop/wrong RIP/missing stop stays incomplete or contradictory identity DENY; no scan, alternate breakpoint or retry.
c0_candidate_and_stop.registers: Whitelisted p register numbers0..23,27..30,32 only (hex0..17,1b..1e,20). Each exact XML-sized reply independently decoded and cross-checked against source-audited HMP CPU0 fields where shared. Exclude CR8/p1f: it can synchronize VAPIC via an implicit physical read. Exclude FP/vector/MXCSR/base registers not needed for this packet. HMP supplies actual CPL, CS64, SMM, GDTR/IDTR and corroborating control registers. An individually audited source path is required for every allowed p/HMP field.
c0_candidate_and_stop.entry_identity: Derive loaded base=actual RIP-pinned entryRVA using checked arithmetic and compare the prior candidate; bound full base+SizeOfImage. Read pinned header extents via fresh checked translation, compare explicit DOS/PE signatures, AMD64/PE32+/EFI subsystem, entryRVA, image/header bounds and section descriptors. PE OptionalHeader.ImageBase is source-authorized to be rewritten to loaded base by EDK II BasePeCoffLib; do not require whole-header byte equality or silently ignore arbitrary differences. Read exact32 entry bytes and compare the existing admission helper's precise supported relocation result. Unsupported/header-overlapping relocation or partial inspected overlap must be denied until explicitly implemented. No whole-image authenticity claim follows.

paging_reader.mode: Require actual CPL0, CS64, CR0.PE+PG, CR4.PAE and EFER.LME+LMA; four-level48-bit canonical addresses. Require LA57, PCIDE, SMAP, SMEP, PKE, PKS and CET disabled for this narrow subset; record CR0.WP and EFER.NXE. Unsupported modes are INCOMPLETE before memory dispatch. Physical width is actual realized CPU property bound to this run, not configured phys-bits=0 or a default guess.
paging_reader.walk: Iterative bounded partial walk at C0, root from actual CR3 after checked supported flags/width. Validate canonical address, entry-present, reserved/high bits, alignment, NX versus NXE and complete effective permissions at every level. Address masks/reserved-bit table must be independently reviewed against pinned Intel/AMD primary architecture text before C0D implementation; no guessed mask. No1GiB leaf unless the reviewed realized/configured feature evidence permits it; pinned qemu64 advertises pdpe1gb=false, so this profile refuses it. Support4KiB/2MiB leaves only initially.
paging_reader.frames: Each discovered whole4096 frame must fit ordinary RAM before reading. Read as two <=2048-byte requests with exact response lengths. Keep raw frame bytes, parent entry offsets/values and derived translations. Reject cycle or incompatible-level reuse, overflow, out-of-width frame or partial backing. Consistent same-level sharing is allowed and deduplicated within the same checkpoint. No recursive whole-memory enumeration.
paging_reader.consistency: After all necessary reads, reread each captured table frame and object extent, then repeat selected register and layout observations before any resume. Exact equality is required; inequality =>INCOMPLETE with both versions retained. This witnesses observed consistency only. Tables/objects must not be combined across stops. Read side effects remain excluded by ordinary-RAM admission, including implicit register paths.
paging_reader.classifications: At C0 emulator ordinary-RAM backing is established; final EFI descriptor classification and full graph remain pending C2. Do not call C0 profile_preconditions_met or establish guest-safe access. The later adapter must revalidate its own state and access assumptions.

public_efi.provenance: Independent UEFI2.10 public definitions plus pinned EDK II edc6681206c1a8791981a2f911d2fb8b3d2f5768 and Cargo.lock uefi-raw0.5.2 repr(C) declarations. These are public layouts, not private Rust struct transmutation. Archive exact reference bytes/sections in the execution dossier.
public_efi.validation: Pinned EDK II revision is (2<<16)|70, hence0x00020046; do not substitute0x00020070. Validate signature, exact profile revision and HeaderSize, reserved0 and IEEE CRC32 over entire table with bytes16..19 zeroed. Reject null/noncanonical/misaligned pointers, truncated tables, overflow, wrong sizes/revision/CRC; no pointer chase before RAM/translation checks. Retain full120/376 bytes. ImageHandle RCX is observed opaque handle; do not dereference it. GetMemoryMap pointer must resolve to executable ordinary RAM and bounded code bytes, without claiming independent firmware function authenticity.
public_efi.onward_abi: C1 on actual GetMemoryMap: RCX=size*, RDX=map*, R8=key*, R9=stride*, fifth version* at [RSP+40]; saved returnRIP at [RSP]. UINTN/pointer64, version32. Bound caller return to actual pinned EFI code/instruction range. C2 must be that same call's saved return with EFI_SUCCESS(RAX=0), same output pointers and live map; no arbitrary subsequent successful firmware call may substitute.

artifact_schema.notation: Every object has exactly its listed fields, unless a literal optional field is stated. No unknown fields. JSON strict UTF-8, no duplicate keys, nonfinite values or bool-as-integer; bounded reads before parse/hash. Types u64/u63 are exact nonnegative integers within width; all additions/multiplications checked. Null means unobserved, never default0. Raw referenced bytes are authoritative; derived values independently recomputed.

BlobRef.path: safe relative ASCII path<=240; no absolute/dotdot/symlink/hardlink

Operation.operation: closed typed operation name from this packet

Termination.actions: array<=8 of bounded actual cleanup action strings

CapabilityReport.raw_refs: array<=16 BlobRef including all socket/stdout/stderr streams
CapabilityReport.operations: array of Operation bounded by shared message cap

C0Report.capability_ref: BlobRef at prior-cap1/report.json for the unchanged same-profile CAP1 report. Resolve its validated flat nested references only under prior-cap1/. Reserve that directory for prior CAP1 and keep current outputs separate. CAP1 is reset evidence only.
C0Report.fresh_c0_verified: bool; true only after all C0 assertions and complete owned teardown

C0Snapshot.breakpoint_seq: u64 original successful Z1 operation seq

TableFrame.read_sequences: array of exactly4 u64 operation seqs

ObjectRead.read_sequences: nonempty bounded array u64 operation seqs

artifact_schema.limits: Input report<=1MiB; raw/log total shared32MiB. Referenced operation payload1..65536 bytes. Hashes of finalized reports live in an external manifest, never self-reference. Termination still written on limit/error with observations null or explicitly partial; seven claims plus two full-profile flags remain exactlyfalse on every path. C0 subset is not cpu_boot_inspection_trace_v0 and must not be registered as a complete Oracle artifact.

assertions.assert: Real socket fragmented/coalesced ACK and packet traffic decodes with exact checksum/escape/raw identity; ACK alone never yields result.
Checksum/NACK/malformed escape/RLE/oversize/unexpected packet/EOF terminate without retransmission; independent byte, expansion, ACK and cumulative caps hold before growth.
Exact qSupported/no-multiprocess and m01/l/QC01/Hg01/Hc01 sequence; duplicate/ambiguous feature or thread mismatch rejects, absent support incomplete.
Only two exact annexes; offset chunks progress without deadline/cap reset. Reject extra include, entity/DTD variation, namespace repair, path traversal, overlap, missing l and changed source bytes.
All66 register offsets and608bytes match independent source inventory; exact little-endian RIP/control scalars; short/long/nonhex/unavailable bytes denied with no padding.
Physical mode0->OK->1 retained without m; unsupported/empty/lying set response never permits further observation.
Every forbidden capability operation has zero wire dispatch. A pre-dispatch denial is followed by a successful allowed query on the same unambiguous real transport.
Delayed fragment/EAGAIN/EINTR/peer stall honor one absolute deadline, no replay or reconnect; subsequent independent client remains usable.
Actual input/observer/source pin or ESP validation failure occurs before Popen; missing evidence incomplete; no modification of prior input/evidence or shared VARS.
Only owned fresh private socket/child and fixed argv. Reject linked/special files and unsafe directories; exact initial/final original pins and clone hashes retained.
Sole CPU0 returned qom-path controls only realized/phys-bits getters. Reject bool-as-width,0,out-of-range,foreign path,multiCPU and synthetic configured width.
Strict ID-bound QMP/HMP allowlist and no RESUME. Reset initial/final prelaunch status and actual HMP0/SMM0/g common fields agree; forbidden commands have no dispatch.
Unique memory/cpu-memory-0 flatview binding and identity pc.ram intervals; synthetic holes/overlays/wrap/ramd/romd/alias/multipleASs rejected without any m.
Real cooperating/stalled child cleanup and late-tail/error controls preserve bounded grace/fallback/reap and actual per-stream EOF; no signal or EOF invention.
Shared message/raw/XML/VARS/report/storage and deadline limits stop before next dispatch and leave bounded terminal report; output errors remain incomplete.

Every success/failure report strictly validates all exact fields and false claims, resumed=false,memoryread0,breakpointtested=false,freshC0=false; duplicate keys/unknowns/nonfinite/bool integers denied.

After rejection or cancellation of an owned session, a fresh unrelated owned fixture succeeds without stale sockets, packet state, budgets or VARS; unchanged existing27 probe controls remain separate evidence.
Prior hint alone cannot create checkpoint; wrong profile/diagnostic/entry/bytes fails. Actual same-run Z1+c+asyncstop+thread+RIP+QMPdebug/HMP witness required; '?' cannot supply it.
No post-resume bulk g or CR8 read, software breakpoint, injected call, write, stepping or virtual m; each individual p/HMP path source-audited.
Entire physical span checked against fresh exact AS ordinary-RAM view before m; boundary crossing, MMIO, ROM, alias, width overflow and unsafe table roots deny before dispatch.

Independent4KiB/2MiB fixtures cover all walk levels, canonical edges, permissions,NX,CR3 flags/reserved bits/cycles/shared frames/depth reuse; unsupported1GiB/CPU mode incomplete without guessed masks.
Actual loaded header identity allows only documented ImageBase rewrite/implemented relocations, matches exact32 entry bytes and full image bounds; malformed/fake PE and unsupported overlap denied.
Independent public header/SystemTable/BootServices offsets, sizes, revision, CRC and GMM pointer tested; bad CRC/NULL/truncation/misalignment/overflow/nonexecutability denied before further chase.
Changed register/layout/table/object recheck remains incomplete, never atomic/device-quiescent claim; snapshots across stops cannot merge; every reread charged.
Exact subset report decodes only retained raw sources; missing/forged/tampered/mislinked refs, unknown fields and counter/length overflows reject. No C1/C2 or full profile acceptance from C0.
Breakpoint removal uncertainty, stop/read timeout, output cap, child failure and missing EOF retain incomplete evidence and owned reap; fresh unrelated fixture works afterward.

execution_prerequisites: Independent interface/assertion freeze and coordinator assignment before implementation.
Reviewed downstream source/package correspondence and exact fresh profile/argv/observer pins before CAP1 launch.
Actual CAP1 observed reset register/XML, realized physical width and effective memory view; unsupported output requires replan, not liberal parsing.
Before C0D: pinned primary architecture reserved-bit/mode rules, independently reviewed layout/page-decoder assertions and exact artifact/API validation.
Before C0C: per-register implicit-read audit, actual breakpoint/stop capability review, independently accepted decoder/collector and root-authorized fresh run.

After C0: same-call C1/C2 typed additions and assertions, complete current C2 graph plus raw-map classifications under unchanged parent bounds. Only then assess full external profile prerequisites; guest access and production retention remain separate.
